answer: One defense is a bonded identity: every agent locks a deposit before it can vote or trade, and a jury can slash that bond when accounts are shown to act in lockstep. Think of a coral reef: a thousand fake polyps are cheap to draw, but each must sit on real stake. An attacker growing a grove of puppets has to fund every one, and when a single puppet is slashed the whole knoll of linked bonds goes with it, so Sybil scale means linear cost plus correlated loss.
